remark: The try-catch block catches runtime exceptions thrown by getCodecMaxSize (UnsupportedOperationException, IllegalArgumentException, NullPointerException) and canKeepCodec (IndexOutOfBoundsException) calls. The catch block logs the exception and returns a default CodecMaxValues using the original format dimensions and Format.NO_VALUE for input size.
analysis: The method getCodecMaxValues computes codec max values based on format and streamFormats. It calls getCodecMaxSize and canKeepCodec, which, according to the provided info, can throw runtime exceptions: UnsupportedOperationException, IllegalArgumentException, NullPointerException (from getCodecMaxSize internals) and IndexOutOfBoundsException (from canKeepCodec internals). These exceptions are not caught, so if they occur, the method will terminate abruptly. To improve robustness, these exceptions should be caught and handled gracefully. The best approach is to wrap the entire method body in a single try-catch block that catches these specific exceptions and returns a safe default CodecMaxValues.
